items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: It wasn't until Martin Luther King came along with his 'Four Hundred Years of Slavery' and 'I Had A Dream' and all that... Well, I'm all for him.

ctx.x: No, not then. None of that stuff those days. Not a bit. It wasn't until Martin Luther King came along with his "Four Hundred Years of Slavery" and "I Had A Dream" and all that... Well, I'm all for him. And I think everybody should
